category: Objects with a Predominantly Round Form
explanation: Wheel, Coin, Donut, and Ball are all typically round or spherical in their most common form. A Brick is typically rectangular.
Four of these are wonders from the ancient world that no longer exist. The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the original Seven Wonders of the Ancient World that is still largely intact today.

category: Words Beginning with a Silent Letter
explanation: All words except 'Table' begin with a silent letter (K in Knot, P in Psychology, W in Wrist, G in Gnome). 'Table' does not have a silent initial letter.
